in_marathi.name: Chidaatma
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Consciousness
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chidaatma हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Chidaatma is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Chid' meaning consciousness and 'Atma' meaning soul. It represents the supreme consciousness that pervades all beings and is the inner self or soul of every individual.
